title: The Hayfield Hop
description: Cross fresh meadow and cut rows, hop the hay stacks, pass through the loading barn and finish in warm golden fields. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

rooms.name: The cut hay rows
rooms.lesson: Cross between the cut rows and drainage channels. Green is open. Amber warns before the press falls.

rooms.name: The high hay bales
rooms.lesson: Commit to the tall stacks · pause on their wide tops. Green is open. Amber warns before the press falls.

rooms.name: The barn loading floor
rooms.lesson: Keep your jumps below the loading beams. Green is open. Amber warns before the press falls.

rooms.name: The golden field
rooms.lesson: Carry your rhythm out into the evening field. Green is open. Amber warns before the press falls.
